_comment: Avatar registry: wallet address (lowercase) -> avatar file name in avatars/. Example: "0x0a90f878e4cf3ef3bc0ee4a67e2ff0166986ad5f": "kong-wave.jpg". Only the site owner adds entries; the profile page never writes here. A registry entry wins over a visitor's own browser pick (localStorage). Entries are replaceable anytime - a new pick overwrites the old one, nothing is locked in.
